use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo

let invariant = CultureInfo.invariant_culture

show(name: string, value: double) =>
    write_line("{name,-22} {value.to_string(invariant)}")

show("positive infinity", double.positive_infinity)
show("negative infinity", double.negative_infinity)
show("from division", 1.0 / 0.0)
show("largest finite double", double.max_value)
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Globalization.CultureInfo

let invariant = CultureInfo.invariant_culture

show(name: string, value: double) =>
    write_line("{name,-22} {value.to_string(invariant)}")

show("positive infinity", double.positive_infinity)
show("negative infinity", double.negative_infinity)
show("from division", 1.0 / 0.0)
show("largest finite double", double.max_value)
output:
positive infinity      Infinity
negative infinity      -Infinity
from division          Infinity
largest finite double  1.7976931348623157E+308
